Chloe / team / Mary — technical notes and constraints below. Keeping it high level for the thread; happy to spin up a short call if needed.

1) Retention window: for Redwood hosted accounts the default retention for access/audit logs is 390 days (13 months) in the region where the account was provisioned. We can produce exports for any period within retention. If the account is on Dedicated with an alternate retention contract, retention follows that commit.

2) Export formats & routing:
   - Standard bundle: gzipped tarball (.tar.gz) containing newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) files per resource + an export_manifest_{ts}.json with SHA256 hashes.
   - Delivery options: a) presigned S3 URL (recommended for one-off downloads; expiry defaults to 7 days), b) server-initiated S3 push to a customer bucket (requires write permissions and agreed bucket ARN), or c) secure SFTP push if the customer provides endpoint details.

3) Residency & chain of custody: logs are stored in the account's region (we can confirm exact AZ/region; export manifest includes storage_region, export_time_utc, and export_operator). The signed manifest will include SHA256 checksums for every file and a signed metadata section (signed by Redwood's export key).

4) PII handling: we support three export modes — RAW, HASHED, REDACTED.
   - RAW: no transformation, full fidelity for forensic work.
   - HASHED: deterministic SHA256 hash of identifiers (not reversible by Redwood) — preserves ability to correlate across logs without exposing raw IDs.
   - REDACTED: identifiers removed or replaced with a token (breaks correlation).
Note: If ACME requests HASHED or REDACTED exports, we will include a manifest field describing the transformation and a separate sample file showing the mapping approach (hashing salt if customer requests it to be customer-managed).

5) Encryption/key handling: for hosted exports we encrypt at rest and in transit using Redwood-managed keys by default. For Dedicated/Private customers or when requested, we can encrypt export bundles with a customer-managed KMS key; for S3 push workflows, we can use server-side encryption with customer KMS if the bucket policy allows.

6) Evidence packaging & timeline: typical package creation is 2-4 business days. Creating both RAW + REDACTED copies doubles processing time; expedited export is possible (next-business-day) with support priority. Chain-of-custody statement and manifest are included in every export.

7) Costs & approvals: exports are included in enterprise support for small/occasional bundles. Very large archives (multi-GB historical reconstructions) may have a one-time export processing fee — Support will surface this during the ticket.

Action items:
- Mary: confirm March 1–31 window, delivery method (presigned vs S3 push), and which PII mode you want (RAW/HASHED/REDACTED).
- Chloe/Neha: open the official Support ticket (EXP-8891) with ACME's requested bucket ARN or contact for presigned link.

References:
- JIRA INF-4721 (export automation runbook): https://jira.redwood.internal/INF-4721
- Export spec doc (internal): https://redwood.app/docs/exports/audit-ndjson

Mary — ops notes / practicalities from platform: 

- If you want a server-initiated S3 push to us-east-2 we need a bucket ARN with the following policy (I'll paste the minimal role policy in the support ticket). Ensure the bucket allows PutObject from the Redwood principal and a KMS key if you want encryption.
- Presigned URL flow: secure and fast. We'll generate 2 files (metadata + tarball) and upload to a temporary bucket; the generated presigned URL will be emailed to the security contact and support lead. Links expire after 7 days by default; we can extend to a max of 14 days for export delivery.
- Manifest & audit: we'll include export_manifest_20270412.json with SHA256, export_operator (redwood ops user id), export_time_utc, and a short chain_of_custody.txt signed by our export key.
- Verification: you can verify file integrity via the manifest and optional detached signature (we can provide a PGP-signed manifest if ACME prefers).

I'll start packaging once the support ticket is created and we have your bucket ARN or confirmation to send presigned links.
